author.name: James R. Bennett
author.about: James R. Bennett is a retired Professor of English who taught at the University of Arkansas, and the co-founder of the Arkansas ACLU.

photo_note: Cropped from a photograph on omnicenter.org (the OMNI Center for Peace, Justice & Ecology, which he founded); the original shows him wearing a name tag reading Dick Bennett, Founder — his byname — which confirms the identification. Cropped to a 600x600 head-and-shoulders square, the name tag out of frame, since the site renders avatars in circles.
